title: Automated Sample Preparation for GNA Octea
author: Opentrons

Using the tips from the previous steps, the P300 Multi-Channel Pipette (GEN2) will transfer the samples from the Temperature Module (GEN2) to the corresponding wells of the Bio-Rad plate on the Magnetic Module (GEN2). The protocol will then delay for three minutes.

steps.title: Heat module and engage magnet
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module (GEN2) to heat to 90 °C and simultaneously engage the Magnetic Module (GEN2).

steps.title: Transfer HB1 and distribute (single‑channel)
steps.instruction: Using the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up a tip, aspirate 360 µL of HB1, dispense into the MB Lyo well, mix, then distribute 40 µL of the mixture to wells adjacent to the sample wells in a NEST 96‑Deep Well Plate (capacity 2 mL).

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette.
Dispense into MB Lyo well and mix.
Distribute 40 µL of the mixture to each adjacent well.

steps.title: Transfer HB1 to plate (multi‑channel)
steps.instruction: Using the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), first transfer 360 µL of HB1 to the previously filled wells of the NEST 96‑Deep Well Plate, change tips, then transfer 300 µL of HB1 to the wells that contain the samples.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip set with the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette.
Aspirate and dispense 360 µL HB1 to the earlier wells.
Discard the tip set and pick up a fresh set.
Aspirate and dispense 300 µL HB1 to the sample wells.

steps.title: Transfer sample‑HB1 mixture
steps.instruction: Using the same tip set from the previous step, transfer the sample + HB1 mixture to the adjacent wells, mix, and then trash the tips.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the sample‑HB1 mixture with the current tips.

steps.title: Transfer 160 µL to Bio‑Rad plate
steps.instruction: With a new set of tips on the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), dispense 160 µL into each well of the first five columns of a Bio‑Rad 96‑Well Plate that sits on a 96‑Well Aluminum Block placed on the Temperature Module (GEN2).

steps.title: Temperature changes and mix samples
steps.instruction: Change the Temperature Module (GEN2) from 90 °C to 80 °C, wait until the temperature is reached, delay for 2 minutes, then change to 56 °C. After the temperature reaches 56 °C, use the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) to mix all samples on the module, and finally deactivate the Temperature Module.

substeps.instruction: Wait for temperature to stabilize, then delay 2 minutes.
Mix all samples on the module with the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette.

steps.title: Transfer samples to Bio‑Rad plate
steps.instruction: Using the tips from the previous steps, the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) transfers the samples from the Temperature Module to the corresponding wells of the Bio‑Rad plate that is now on the Magnetic Module (GEN2), then pause for 3 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each sample to its matching well on the Bio‑Rad plate.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh set of tips with the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), lower the flow rate, aspirate the supernatant from each well, and dispense it into liquid waste located in Well 12 of the NEST 12‑Well Reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Reduce flow rate for supernatant removal.
Dispense supernatant into Well 12 of the NEST 12‑Well Reservoir.

steps.title: Add WB1 to samples and mix
steps.instruction: Pick up a new tip set with the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), transfer WB1 to the samples on the Magnetic Module, mix thoroughly, and recombine the samples in column 5.

substeps.instruction: Transfer WB1 to each sample well on the Magnetic Module.
Recombine the mixed samples into column 5.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module (GEN2) and wait 3 minutes. After the pause, the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) removes the supernatant from the sample wells and discards it into liquid waste.

steps.title: Transfer RB1 and distribute
steps.instruction: Using the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), aspirate 350 µL of RB1, dispense into the well containing the MM Lyo, mix, then distribute 40 µL of the mixture to each sample well on the Magnetic Module (GEN2).

substeps.instruction: Dispense into MM Lyo well and mix.
Distribute 40 µL to each sample well on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Mix column 5 samples
steps.instruction: Pick up a new tip set with the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) and mix the samples in column 5 on the Magnetic Module, which now contain sample, RB1, and MM Lyo.

steps.title: Transfer samples to GNA Octea chip
steps.instruction: For each of the eight sample wells on the Magnetic Module (GEN2), pick up a fresh tip with the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) and transfer the sample to the corresponding well on the custom plate that holds the GNA Octea Chip.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to the matching well on the GNA Octea chip plate.
